title: Plant Overtime Notice: Federal Holidays Inside an Expedited Build — Factory Production Orders
content:
**Notice.** For Factory Production Orders built on an expedited schedule, a holiday overtime add-on is charged per unit on the order by the U.S. federal holidays that fall on weekdays after the request date up to and including the expedited target ship date:

| Weekday federal holidays in that span | Add-on |
|---|---|
| two or more | 15 dollars per unit on the order |
| one | 8 dollars per unit on the order |
| none | nothing |

The expedited target ship date is the request date plus the class expedite lead time in business days. The add-on is added to the per-unit charge of the expedite before that sum is compared with the class minimum expedite fee.

## Points of reading

- The span opens the day after the request date and closes on the expedited target ship date itself; a holiday on the request date does not count, and a holiday on the target date would.
- Only holidays falling Monday through Friday count.
- The add-on is per unit on the factory order record, not per opening.

## Hypothetical examples

- A 10-unit order with one weekday federal holiday in the span: 10 units at 8 dollars, 80.00.
- A 10-unit order with two such holidays: 10 units at 15 dollars, 150.00.
